lines.en: : Yumi?
: I know it’s you. I saw your name on the-
: Where are you?
: I’m...right where you left me. I told you I didn’t have anything else going on tonight. And I didn’t really have it in me to leave, so-
: Can we meet up?
: Is...everything okay?
: Please...can we just meet up?
: Where and when? I’ll head over now.
: I’m...near the bath house. Just walking. But I can stop.
: I thought you were-
: Yumi?
I should have stopped her when she told me where she was going.
I know Yuki’s been all over the place lately, but I figured she’d have at least managed to hold out and not be a complete fuck-up if she had plans with Yumi.
She’s tried so hard to make things right with her. And I really don’t want to believe she’d just throw that all away out of nowhere, but...
I guess it’s just a lot more tempting to ruin everything once it’s all neatly laid out before you.
No...
I shouldn’t make assumptions just yet. Even when I know they’re the most likely scenario.
I need to hear what happened first. I need to see with my own eyes just what-
Before I know it, I’m here.
I spoke to myself throughout the whole trip because no one else would. And throughout that time, I repeated those same words over and over.
I need to hear what happened. I need to see it with my own eyes.
But this isn’t what I wanted to see. Why would I think that?
Why would I subject myself to the pain that will surely come from whatever it is she has to say when I know complaining about it will only make me look weak when compared to her?
Who am I to pretend to know that sting? The kind she’s not only felt countless times in the past, but has been openly prepared for ever since letting that woman back into her-
No.
I need to hear what happened. I need to see it with my own eyes.
I need to be a father.
She has no one else.
They’ve all fallen off the ledge.
: I’m here.
: Thank you.
: So what’s-
: I don’t...want to talk about it.
: And I didn’t want to...bother you again. But Chika’s...a whole thing and...Noriko’s at work.
: I ain’t got nobody else.
: But...you don’t want to talk about it.
: Not...right now at least.
: I just didn’t want to be alone.
: Where do you want to go then? Because I doubt you want to be out here in the cold.
: Anywhere. I don’t care.
: Alone though, right?
: I already told you. I don’t care.
: Well...you still have Chika’s old apartment, don’t you?
: Technically. They shut off the power, though. I didn’t know how to pay the bill and...I felt weird about asking Chika.
: Well, we can’t go to my house because of Ami and my secret pop-star girlfriend. And we can’t go to my secret apartment because of my secret gyaru girlfriend. So...what does that leave us with?
: Karaoke booth?
: Pass. I have bad luck in those. I’ll probably attack you again.
: Go for it. Fuck if I care anymore.
: It’s going to be okay, Yumi.
: Spare me the bullshit, okay? I don’t need you to console me or baby me or pretend you know what’s going on. I just...
: I don’t want to be alone...
: You really don’t care where we go?
: Just pick somewhere nobody else is gonna bother me.
: Tragedy follows you the same way it follows me, though. So chances are, shit ain’t gonna be calm no matter where you fuckin’ take me.
: Do you mind if I make a phone call really quick?
: Please don’t fucking get Chika involved. I really don’t want to deal with her right now.
: I’m not. I’m just going to call Ami and tell her I’m not coming home tonight.
: What? Why?
: You’ll see.
: But-
: Just hold on one second, okay?
The phone only rings once. Ami never lets it go any longer.
: Hi Dad! Miss you! Love you! Come have sex with me?
: Well, I’m glad I didn’t have you on speakerphone just now.
: Boooo. I was hoping you did. What’s up?
: I’m not coming home tonight. Could you let Niki know too?
: Uhh...why? If I’m...allowed to ask.
: Are you sure you want to?
: Are you sure I’m not going to find out anyway?
: Just tell Niki, okay? And don’t worry about me. I’m safe.
: Well, what am I supposed to tell Aunt Niki then?
: I don’t know, you’ll come up with something.
: But Dad-
: I love you. Okay?
: Fine...
: But you owe me extra cuddles tomorrow! No exceptions.
: I’ll see what I can do. Goodnight, Ami.
: Night, Dad.
: Please stay safe.
: Hearing you be all cute with your little incest demon like that seriously makes me sick.
: Don’t listen then. I don’t know what to tell you.
: Hah...Now what? You’ve clearly got a plan. Let’s hear it.
: Yeah, I’m gonna need you to just go along with me on this one and not ask any questions.
: I’m gonna wake up in a trunk tomorrow, aren’t I?
: Worse.
: Fantastic.
: Come on. Follow me. It’s not that far.
: Go slow, please. I don’t have the energy right now.
I do as she says, matching her pace on the way to somewhere I can’t imagine she’d ever follow me under normal circumstances.
: A love hotel? Really?
: It’s cheap. It’s private. And we can stay as long as we want.
: Plus, there are complimentary condoms in the event that you want to have sex with me to take your mind off of everything.
: Thanks. I’ll keep that in mind.
: Please don’t. It was only a joke to lighten the mood. Going down the same path I take to deal with pain isn’t something I wish upon virgins like you.
: It’s fine. This is fine too. We can just...watch TV or something.
: And...not talk.
: Yeah.
: Are you sure that’s what-
: Jesus Christ, yes. You gonna ask me that all night?
: Well, forgive me, but it’s not every day I get a call from a you who’s clearly struggling with something. I want to help.
: Then just let me go at my own fuckin’ pace, okay? Our whole fuckin’ relationship is you tryin’ to dictate that shit for me. Just give it a fucking break already.
: Fine...I’ll just...stare at you then.
: Stare at the TV. They’ve gotta have something on there that ain’t just porn, right? Put something on. I don’t want silence.
I grab the remote and-
: Aah! Aah! Harder, Daddy! Fuck me with your big, hard cock!
: Next, please.
I change the channel.
: Aah! Aah! Harder, Daddy! Fuck me with your big, hard cock!
: This is the same thing, just with two dudes instead.
I change the channel again.
: I see you don’t have a lifeguard here at your beach.
: I’m not at the beach. This is a bathtub.
: No body of water is safe without a lifeguard.
: It’s two feet deep, lady. What are you doing here?
: This is porn too, isn’t it?
: No, this is a bathtub.
I change the channel one last time because Yumi isn’t ready for greatness yet.
: Oh, good. A talk show. I hope they’re wearing pants beneath that desk.
: Anything can be porn when you think about it that way.
: You ain’t wrong, I guess. Ready to shut up for the rest of the night?
: Did you really just want me here to take up space?
: There a problem with that?
: I mean...not really. But if this is just you being a tsundere again while you work up the courage to say something-
: I don’t know what to fucking say! Okay?!

: I don’t know what to think! I don’t know what to do! I just want to sit here and wait for all of this to be over! So stop fucking reminding me that everything is going to shit! Okay?! I know! I fucking know!
: Just...
: If you really want to help, just sit with me. That’s all I want.
: Okay.
I stop prying and just...exist in the same place as Yumi — letting the booming voices of some exuberant TV personalities drown out the distant sounds of other couples having sex.
And while we both know that’s happening, neither one of us ever really reacts apart from a quick glance at the wall to try and confirm climaxes behind the scenes.
There is no “gradually getting closer” or “the crumbling of whatever walls we’ve put between us.” Just...TV. The light that bleeds out of it. Sadness. Free condoms we’ll never use.
This goes on for hours. And the only change in the environment is the way the bed shifts when one of us gets up to use the restroom or get a drink of water.
It always ends the same way, though — right back here on the bed. Where we’ll stay until Yumi has sufficiently rotted the misery out of her body.
I guess it might take a little longer than just a few hours, though.
: I really am okay with sleeping on the floor, Yumi.
: I’m not gonna fuckin’ make you do that. Who knows when the last time they cleaned this carpet is?
: It’s not that bad when you think about how many people have had their cum washed out of these sheets.
: Great. Now I’m definitely not going to be able to sleep.
: Yeah...I doubt I will either.
: Don’t say something creepy, please. I don’t want to deal with it right now.
: I won’t. I’m moreover just talking about how I don’t normally sleep fully clothed. But I’m making that sacrifice for you.
: Way to take one for the team.
We’re not touching, but we might as well be.
I can feel the heat from her body, embracing me from behind like it's the big spoon and I’m a plastic fork someone pulled from the trash to eat leftovers from a takeout container.
She seems calmer now, at least. Turns out keeping my mouth shut really did help in some capacity.
But it doesn’t change the fact that I want to know what’s going on inside of her head.
I guess that was true before tonight, though.
I guess I’ve always wanted to know more about her. And I guess she’s...finally okay with me wanting that if she’s going to trust me to sleep in the same bed as her.
I could ruin it so easily. And it wouldn’t even have to be intentional.
She knows it too.
She knows it, and she’s trusting me anyway.
I can only imagine how much she must be hurting if that’s the case.
: Sensei?...
: ...Yeah?
: What was your mom like?
: I can’t remember...
: I see...
: Why do you ask?
: Chika makes her mom sound like the greatest woman who ever existed...
: Ayane seems like she was crazy about hers too...
: Four-eyes doesn’t seem to like hers that much, but she didn’t seem that bad when I met her.
: Is it hard?...
: Raising a kid?...
: It’s gotta be, right?...
: It is...
: I...haven’t been doing it for long, though.
: Ain’t you been with Ami for like half her life?
: Yeah, but I didn’t start trying until recently.
: Her mother...
: Was also amazing, though. In her own ways.
: Yeah?...
: Yeah.
: Are you still awake?
: Yeah...
: Do you want me to turn the TV back on?
: No...it’s fine.
: And you’re sure you don’t want me to sleep on the floor?
: Don’t leave me, please.
: I...won’t. I’m shocked you’d word that so embarrassingly, though.
: I need you here.
: I really do.
: You know...
: And let me just preface this by saying I’m not trying to get you to talk to me right now...but you can rely on me whenever you need, Yumi.
: I know...that’s why I called you.
: You...You definitely don’t...make me feel safe or anything but...I...feel safe when you’re with me? Does that...make sense?
: No. No, that doesn’t make sense at all. But as long as you know.
: Yeah...I know.
: I’m gonna try and go to sleep now...
: Okay...
: I’ll do the same then.
: Okay...
: Wake me up if you need anything.
: Okay...
: Goodnight, Yumi.
: Goodnight, Sensei...
: I think my mom has cancer.
: What?...
: She got a letter in the mail today...
: I saw something about...um...
: I forget the word...I...
: She’s seemed...weird lately...
: Do you think she-
: Thank you...
I don’t say anything.
How could I?
I just hold her and hope, by the means of some miracle, that the world we’re in will fix it.
Is that too much?
It’s not...right?
: I’m...gonna try and go to sleep again.
: And I’m out of bad news to spring on you out of nowhere this time, so...
: I’ll be here.
: Yeah...
: Thank you...
: Sensei...
